reviewSamples.author: Krista "KnG" Vickery
reviewSamples.text: Our cocker spaniel loved her pampering day!!! She was pretty well very long hair and was able to get her down to begin fresh. Loved the experience.

reviewSamples.author: Sarah Black
reviewSamples.text: If I could give Edina 10 stars, I would, and we haven't even used her grooming services yet! We had to cancel at the last minute as our poor boy had an ulcerated cornea. Edina was amazing.

reviewSamples.author: Lauren The Lady
reviewSamples.text: It was very easy to reach out and schedule an appointment with The Barking Lot! They made our dogs feel comfortable by giving them pets and treats right away. When the dogs came back their coats were gorgeous & smooth, breath had no smell.

reviewSamples.author: Andrea Merritt
reviewSamples.text: Edina has been grooming our medium sized labs for over 10 years. One of our dogs had major knee surgery a little over a year ago and we knew that grooming her would be a challenge since our furry child can't stand for long periods of time.

reviewSamples.author: Laura Simmons
reviewSamples.text: My Golden retriever Nemo absolutely LOVED Edina - he always seemed to know when she was coming and spend the day pacing to the window to wait for her - she always did an amazing job
